name: Chord save letter guard
description: The v1.9 save cave, plus a guard so a save of a non-active pattern letter no longer writes the active letter's live chord bank over the other letter's sidecar. Stock allows dirty or forced non-active patterns through this writer; the bank only ever holds the active letter, so the only correct action for another letter is to leave its sidecar alone.

asm: push {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, lr}
@ r4 is still the pattern pointer; r8 becomes the caller's stack frame
@ the frame holds the ASCII letter; the offset needs the 0-based index
@ drum (type 1) has no chord bank to save
@ find the track's index in the same table the fan-out uses
@ only the active letter's chords are live in the bank; saving another letter must not
@ overwrite that letter's sidecar with them
@ close the pattern file the caller opened
pop {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, lr}
